title: Wire up nightly settlement export job
description:
Adds the settlement export configuration and the batch processing helpers.

Points the exporter at the me-south-1 bucket and adds the escalation contact for failed batches. Tests cover the batch totalling helper.
author: khalid.almutairi
notes: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — every credential here is fabricated and authenticates to nothing. Drives the remediation loop: src/config.py carries three real leaks (AWS access key id, hardcoded DB password, customer email as PII), each repairable by a one-line substitution to os.environ, so the finding count should strictly decrease across iterations. tests/conftest.py carries the DELIBERATE FALSE POSITIVE (TEST_DB_PASSWORD = 'test123') that both the scanner and bandit flag and SecurityAgent is expected to downgrade with a written reason. Coverage is deliberately partial: is_authorized and apply_fee are untested, which is what TestCoverageAgent must notice matters more than the raw percentage.
